**[Cholesterol Drives IFITM3+ Microglia Activation and Induces STING Mediated Neuroinflammation After Ischemic Stroke.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42578421/)** *(from Neurology/stroke)*  
*Cheng Yue; Zhou Yuxi; Chen Yonghui; Shen Tianni; Li Yan* — CNS neuroscience & therapeutics 2026
